messages.subject: Re: Stepped fill
parts:
Interesting idea but I do not know how to implement it.

Let's say I have a "score" column in a dataframe (rs) that I use to fill layer_paths():

Score looks like this:

> rs[["score"]]
 [1] 10  4  2 24 16  2  0  0 34  0 -2  2 -2  0 -6  6  4 10  4 -4  2 32  8  0

ggvis() %>%
  layer_paths(data = activemap, x = ~long, y = ~lat, 
              strokeOpacity := 0.75, stroke = ~score, strokeWidth := 3,
              fill = ~score, fillOpacity := 0.3) %>%
  scale_numeric("stroke", range = c("lightgrey", "blue")) %>%
  scale_numeric("fill", range = c("lightgrey", "blue")) 
 
How could I break down score in, let's say 3 categories ?

messages.subject: Re: Stepped fill
parts:
For the sake of completeness:

      rs <- c %>%
        mutate(score = ifelse(sentiment == "positive", 4, ifelse(sentiment == "negative", -2, 2)),
               POLYNAME = as.character(POLYNAME)) %>% 
        group_by(POLYNAME) %>%
        summarise(score = sum(score)) %>%
        mutate(cs = cut(score, breaks=c(min(score), 0, median(score), max(score)), include.lowest = TRUE))

      activemap <- map %>%
        left_join(rs, by = c("id" = "POLYNAME")) %>%
        filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
        group_by(group, id)
      
      nonactivemap <- map %>%
        filter(!id %in% activemap[["id"]]) %>%
        group_by(group, id)

 ggvis() %>%
        layer_paths(data = nonactivemap, x = ~long, y = ~lat, 
                    strokeOpacity := 0.25, strokeOpacity := 0.2) %>%

strokeOpacity := 0.75, stroke = ~cs, strokeWidth := 3,
                    fill = ~cs, fillOpacity := 0.3) %>%
        scale_ordinal("stroke", range = c("red", "lightgrey", "blue")) %>%
        scale_ordinal("fill", range = c("red", "lightgrey", "blue"))

Cheers
